# PM032: good-first-pool-low

> Generated: do not edit this page. Regenerate with `cargo dev gen rules`.

| since | 2.0.0 |

Fewer than `[tickets] good_first_min` ready tickets carry the `good-first` label.

Reports the ready count and the minimum. A minimum of 0 turns the rule off.

## Remedy

Label more ready tickets `good-first` (with a `## Start here` section), or lower
`[tickets] good_first_min` in `frob.toml`.

## Examples

### PM032 good-first pool low / Two ready good-first tickets fires with the count and the minimum #1 (line 9) (fire)

```text
task a labels=good-first
task b labels=good-first
```

### PM032 good-first pool low / Three ready good-first tickets is silent #2 (line 16) (clean)

```text
task a labels=good-first
task b labels=good-first
task c labels=good-first
```

### PM032 good-first pool low / Unlabelled and in-progress tickets do not count #3 (line 24) (fire)

```text
task a labels=good-first
task b labels=good-first
task c
task d labels=good-first state=in_progress
```

### PM032 good-first pool low / A minimum of 0 turns the rule off #4 (line 33) (clean)

```text
good_first_min 0
task a
```
